tasks.question: Where is a user account disabled after too many failed login attempts, and which event is raised when that happens?

tasks.verifiedBy: Read UserManager.cs@v10.11.11: on a failed login AuthenticateUser increments InvalidLoginAttemptCount and, when it reaches LoginAttemptsBeforeLockout, sets PermissionKind.IsDisabled and publishes new UserLockedOutEventArgs(user) (lines 636-648).

tasks.question: Where is the `Authorization: MediaBrowser Client=..., Token=...` header parsed into key/value pairs, including the legacy header name?

tasks.verifiedBy: Read AuthorizationContext.cs@v10.11.11: GetAuthorizationDictionary reads Authorization (or X-Emby-Authorization when EnableLegacyAuthorization), GetAuthorization(ReadOnlySpan<char>) checks the 'MediaBrowser'/'Emby' scheme and GetParts splits key="value" pairs with quote/comma handling and URL decoding.

tasks.question: When a user logs in with a password stored under an older hash algorithm or iteration count, where is it verified and transparently re-hashed?
tasks.search: password hash verify login migrate old hash iterations
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v10.11.11: DefaultAuthenticationProvider.Authenticate(username, password, resolvedUser) parses the stored PasswordHash, calls _cryptographyProvider.Verify (PBKDF2 / PBKDF2-SHA512) and, when the hash id differs from DefaultHashMethod or iterations != Constants.DefaultIterations, calls ChangePassword to re-hash.

tasks.question: Where does `MediaSegmentManager` run the enabled media segment providers for an item, in the order configured for the library?
tasks.verifiedBy: Read MediaSegmentManager.cs@v10.11.11: RunSegmentPluginProviders filters _segmentProviders by libraryOptions.DisabledMediaSegmentProviders (via GetProviderId), orders them by libraryOptions.MediaSegmentProviderOrder, optionally deletes existing segments and runs each provider that supports the item.

tasks.question: Explain the Quick Connect flow: how a new device gets a code, how a signed-in user authorizes it, and how the device then obtains its session.
tasks.search: quick connect code device authorize user session secret
tasks.verifiedBy: Read QuickConnectManager.cs@v10.11.11: TryConnect creates a QuickConnectResult with a secure secret and a generated code; CheckRequestStatus polls by secret; AuthorizeRequest(userId, code) authenticates the user and stores the AuthenticationResult under the secret; GetAuthorizedRequest(secret) returns it. All four call ExpireRequests first.

tasks.question: How are trickplay (seek preview) images generated for a video: which widths and interval are used, and how are the extracted frames combined into tile sheets?
tasks.search: trickplay images generate video widths interval tiles
tasks.verifiedBy: Read TrickplayManager.cs@v10.11.11: RefreshTrickplayDataAsync checks CanGenerateTrickplay, clamps Interval to >= 1000 ms and loops options.WidthResolutions calling RefreshTrickplayDataInternal, which extracts frames with ExtractVideoImagesOnIntervalAccelerated and calls CreateTiles to assemble TileWidth x TileHeight sheets.

tasks.question: In SyncPlay, while some group members are still buffering, how does the group wait for everyone to be ready before it resumes playback?
